wikidata-meteorites-mass.json.what: Wikidata Query Service, SPARQL results (JSON): items that are instances of meteorite (Q60186) or its subclasses and state a mass (P2067), with the mass's amount and unit, and optional coordinates (P625), time of discovery (P575) and point in time (P585), English labels.
wikidata-meteorites-mass.json.query: SELECT ?m ?mLabel ?amount ?unit ?coord ?found ?fell WHERE { ?m wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q60186 . ?m p:P2067/psv:P2067 [ wikibase:quantityAmount ?amount ; wikibase:quantityUnit ?unit ] . OPTIONAL{?m wdt:P625 ?coord} OPTIONAL{?m wdt:P575 ?found} OPTIONAL{?m wdt:P585 ?fell} SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } }
wikidata-meteorites-mass.json.why: Tonight's material. Chosen after the NASA Meteorite Landings file (data.nasa.gov) could not be fetched (F-204).

not_reached.https://data.nasa.gov/docs/legacy/meteor: five attempts, connection reset by the proxy tunnel each time, 2026-10-08 ~23:04 UTC; the portal's package_search API answered and named this file, licence 'not specified'
